data.description: Brand New | Great Location | Large Layout
data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate
 is proud to present this stunning 3-bedroom townhouse for rent in Bliss.

Property Features:
• 3 Bedrooms
• 3 Bathrooms
• Plot Size: 1,269 sqft
• BUA: 2,246 sqft
• Maid’s Room
• Laundry Room
• Unfurnished
• Vacant
• Brand New
• Community Views
• 2 Covered Parking Spaces
• Next to Community Amenities
• Asking Price: AED 160,000 in 2 Cheques

This beautifully designed townhouse offers a spacious and functional layout ideal for family living. The bright open-plan living and dining area is complemented by modern finishes and large windows that allow natural light throughout the home.

The bedrooms are generously sized with built-in wardrobes, while the master bedroom provides added comfort and privacy. The property also includes a maid’s room and dedicated laundry area for everyday convenience.

Located in the sought-after Bliss community within Arabian Ranches 3, residents enjoy a peaceful neighborhood with excellent amenities, landscaped surroundings, and easy access to major roads and key destinations across Dubai.

For more information or to arrange a viewing, contact us today.
